short: emotional style, and how closeness is approached
text: In traditional palmistry the heart line, which runs across the upper palm beneath the fingers, is linked with emotional style and how closeness is approached. It is read as a theme of temperament, not as a statement about any particular relationship.

short: a long line is often read as openness and warmth in how feelings are shared
text: In traditional palmistry a long heart line is often read as openness and warmth in how feelings are shared. It describes a style of feeling, not how many relationships a person has.

short: a line of medium length is often read as a balanced way of handling feelings
text: In traditional palmistry a heart line of medium length is often read as a balanced way of handling feelings, neither held back nor given away freely.

short: a shorter line is often read as a more private, self-contained emotional style
text: In traditional palmistry a shorter heart line is often read as a more private, self-contained emotional style. It is not read as a lack of feeling.

short: a straighter course is traditionally linked with a measured, direct manner
text: In traditional palmistry a straighter heart line is linked with a measured, direct manner in matters of feeling.

short: a gentle curve is often associated with an easygoing, affectionate manner
text: In traditional palmistry a gently curved heart line is often associated with an easygoing, affectionate manner.

short: a pronounced curve is often associated with expressive, demonstrative feelings
text: In traditional palmistry a heart line with a pronounced curve is often associated with expressive, demonstrative feelings.

short: a clearly marked line is read as feelings that are easy to recognise
text: In traditional palmistry a clearly marked heart line is read as feelings that are easy to recognise.

short: a deeply marked line is traditionally read as strongly felt emotions
text: In traditional palmistry a deeply marked heart line is read as strongly felt emotions.

short: thinking style, curiosity and attention
text: In traditional palmistry the head line, which runs across the middle of the palm from the edge between the thumb and the index finger, is linked with thinking style, curiosity and attention. It describes how a mind tends to work, not how intelligent a person is.

short: a long line is often read as thorough, wide-ranging thinking
text: In traditional palmistry a long head line is often read as thorough, wide-ranging thinking.

short: a line of medium length is often read as a balance of practical and imaginative thought
text: In traditional palmistry a head line of medium length is often read as a balance of practical and imaginative thought.

short: a shorter line is often read as quick, direct thinking that likes to get to the point
text: In traditional palmistry a shorter head line is often read as quick, direct thinking that likes to get to the point. It is not read as a sign of lower intelligence.

short: a straight course is traditionally linked with practical, logical habits
text: In traditional palmistry a straight head line is linked with practical, logical habits of mind.

short: a gentle slope is linked with a flexible mix of logic and imagination
text: In traditional palmistry a gently sloping head line is linked with a flexible mix of logic and imagination.

short: a steeper slope is linked with an imaginative, creative turn of mind
text: In traditional palmistry a head line that slopes more steeply is linked with an imaginative, creative turn of mind.

short: a clearly marked line is read as a clear, settled way of thinking
text: In traditional palmistry a clearly marked head line is read as a clear, settled way of thinking.

short: a deeply marked line is traditionally read as strong focus
text: In traditional palmistry a deeply marked head line is read as strong focus.

short: energy, vitality and how steadily one moves through change (it says nothing about how long anyone will live)
text: In traditional palmistry the life line, which curves around the base of the thumb, is linked with energy, vitality and how steadily a person moves through change. Older books also link it with health and length of life, but this reading does not use those claims, because a photo of a palm cannot say anything about either.

short: a long line is often read as steady stamina
text: In traditional palmistry a long life line is often read as steady stamina. It is a theme of energy, not of how long anyone will live.

short: a line of medium length is often read as a balanced rhythm of effort and rest
text: In traditional palmistry a life line of medium length is often read as a balanced rhythm of effort and rest.

short: a shorter line is often read as a compact, selective use of energy, and it is not about lifespan
text: In traditional palmistry a shorter life line is often read as a compact, selective use of energy. It is not about lifespan.

short: a straighter course is often linked with a calm, even pace
text: In traditional palmistry a straighter life line is often linked with a calm, even pace.

short: a gentle, wide sweep is linked with generous energy and enthusiasm
text: In traditional palmistry a gentle, wide sweep of the life line is linked with generous energy and enthusiasm.

short: a deeply curved sweep around the thumb is linked with zest and a love of activity
text: In traditional palmistry a deeply curved sweep of the life line around the thumb is linked with zest and a love of activity.

short: a clearly marked line is read as energy that is easy to rely on
text: In traditional palmistry a clearly marked life line is read as energy that is easy to rely on.

short: a deeply marked line is traditionally read as strong vitality
text: In traditional palmistry a deeply marked life line is read as strong vitality.

short: sense of direction and self-direction (many hands have no distinct fate line, and that means nothing is missing)
text: In traditional palmistry the fate line, also called the destiny line, runs up the middle of the palm toward the middle finger and is linked with a sense of direction and self-direction. Many hands have no distinct fate line, and that is not read as anything missing.

short: a long line is often read as a strong sense of direction
text: In traditional palmistry a long fate line is often read as a strong sense of direction.

short: a line of medium length is often read as direction that firms up over time
text: In traditional palmistry a fate line of medium length is often read as direction that firms up over time.

short: a shorter line is often read as a flexible, improvised path
text: In traditional palmistry a shorter fate line is often read as a flexible, improvised path.

short: a straight line is read as a steady sense of purpose
text: In traditional palmistry a straight fate line is read as a steady sense of purpose.

short: a gently drifting line is read as adaptable plans
text: In traditional palmistry a gently drifting fate line is read as adaptable plans.

short: a curving line is read as changes of course along the way
text: In traditional palmistry a curving fate line is read as changes of course along the way.

short: a clearly marked line is read as a clear sense of what matters
text: In traditional palmistry a clearly marked fate line is read as a clear sense of what matters.

short: a deeply marked line is traditionally read as strong determination
text: In traditional palmistry a deeply marked fate line is read as strong determination.

short: creativity, appreciation and what brings a sense of satisfaction
text: In traditional palmistry the sun line, also called the Apollo line, runs up the palm toward the ring finger and is linked with creativity, appreciation and what brings a sense of satisfaction. Older books also link it with fame and success; this reading keeps only the gentler themes. Many hands have no distinct sun line, and that is not read as anything missing.

short: a long line is often read as a strong appetite for creative or appreciative pursuits
text: In traditional palmistry a long sun line is often read as a strong appetite for creative or appreciative pursuits.

short: a line of medium length is often read as a quiet enjoyment of beauty and recognition
text: In traditional palmistry a sun line of medium length is often read as a quiet enjoyment of beauty and recognition.

short: a shorter line is often read as satisfaction found in small, private things
text: In traditional palmistry a shorter sun line is often read as satisfaction found in small, private things.

short: a straight line is read as steady, unforced creativity
text: In traditional palmistry a straight sun line is read as steady, unforced creativity.

short: a gently bending line is read as a playful, varied imagination
text: In traditional palmistry a gently bending sun line is read as a playful, varied imagination.

short: a pronounced bend is read as bursts of inspiration
text: In traditional palmistry a sun line with a pronounced bend is read as bursts of inspiration.

short: a clearly marked line is read as creativity that is easy to see in everyday life
text: In traditional palmistry a clearly marked sun line is read as creativity that is easy to see in everyday life.

short: a deeply marked line is traditionally read as a strong creative drive
text: In traditional palmistry a deeply marked sun line is read as a strong creative drive.
